Get CEBL Player Game Log

Source: R/cebl.R
cebl_player_gamelog.Rd

One player's game log: one row per game played, with the Genius match id of the game.

Endpoint: GET https://api.data.cebl.ca/players/{player_id}/gamelog/

Usage

cebl_player_gamelog(player_id, season = NULL, competition = NULL)

Arguments

player_id

(required) CEBL player id (global across seasons and teams), e.g. 570965 (Javonte Smart); player_id in cebl_player_stats.

season

(default NULL) Season: the calendar year (May to August) = the sdv END year. NULL = every season combined (the Stats Hub's All-Time). An unknown year answers hoopR_no_data.

competition

(default NULL) REGULAR (regular season) or FINALS (the playoffs). NULL = both.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One player's game log: one row per game played, with the Genius match id of the game. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cebl_player_gamelog):

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerCEBL player id of the log asked for (from the request; the body does not echo it).
seasonintegerSeason of the game: the year of game_date (the calendar year = the sdv END year).
game_datePOSIXctTip-off of the game, ISO 8601 in UTC (same as the game's start_time_utc).
genius_match_idintegerGenius LiveStats match id parsed from the stats URL (the join to the genius family, organisation CEBL, where play-by-play and shots live). Derived from the URL, not fetched; null when the URL is absent.
team_abbreviated_namecharacterThree-letter code of the player's team in that game ('OTT').
matchupcharacter'{TEAM} {team score} {vs or @} {opponent score} {OPP}': the player's team code and score first; vs = a home game, @ = an away game ('OTT 91 @ 95 BHB').
minutesdoubleMinutes played as decimal minutes (26.4), not mm:ss; the API sends a string.
pointsintegerPoints scored in the game. An integer.
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made (2- and 3-pointers) in the game. An integer.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted (2- and 3-pointers) in the game. An integer.
field_goal_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the game. A string.
three_points_madeintegerThree-pointers made in the game. An integer.
three_points_attemptedintegerThree-pointers attempted in the game. An integer.
three_point_percentagedoubleThree-point percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the game. A string.
free_throws_madeintegerFree throws made in the game. An integer.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted in the game. An integer.
free_throw_percentagedoubleFree-throw percentage, 0-100 with 1 decimal ('44.7'): made / attempted over the game. A string.
offensive_reboundsintegerOffensive rebounds in the game. An integer.
defensive_reboundsintegerDefensive rebounds in the game. An integer.
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds in the game; the API sends it as a string ('5'), cast to Int64.
assistsintegerAssists in the game. An integer.
turn_oversintegerTurnovers in the game. An integer.
stealsintegerSteals in the game. An integer.
blocksintegerShots blocked in the game. An integer.
foulsintegerPersonal fouls committed in the game. An integer.
is_target_scorerlogicalTrue when the player made the basket that reached the Elam Ending target score and ended the game.
game_stats_url_encharactercebl.ca game page, https://www.cebl.ca/game?id={matchId}: id is the Genius match id (the join to genius-livestats/).
game_stats_url_frcharacterFrench cebl.ca game page (https://www.cebl.ca/fr-ca/game?id={matchId}).
team_stats_url_encharactercebl.ca stats page of the player's team in that game (English).
team_stats_url_frcharactercebl.ca stats page of the player's team in that game (French).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cebl_seasons().

 cebl_player_gamelog(player_id = 570965, season = 2025)
